questions.question: Per Section 0, what does "ampacity" mean?
options: A) The current a conductor can carry continuously under the conditions of use without exceeding its temperature rating
B) The maximum current a conductor can carry for a short time during a fault
C) The rated current marked on the overcurrent device protecting the conductor
D) The total connected load supplied by a feeder or branch circuit
questions.question_fa: طبق Section 0، اصطلاح ampacity به چه معناست؟
options_fa: جریانی که یک هادی می‌تواند به‌طور پیوسته تحت شرایط استفاده، بدون فراتر رفتن از temperature rating خود حمل کند
حداکثر جریانی که یک هادی می‌تواند برای مدت کوتاهی در حین یک fault حمل کند
جریان rated که روی overcurrent device حافظ هادی marked شده
کل بار متصل که توسط یک feeder یا branch circuit تغذیه می‌شود
questions.answer_fa: جریانی که یک هادی می‌تواند به‌طور پیوسته تحت شرایط استفاده، بدون فراتر رفتن از temperature rating خود حمل کند
questions.answer: The current a conductor can carry continuously under the conditions of use without exceeding its temperature rating
solution_steps: Keyword: 'ampacity'. The defining clauses are 'continuously' and 'without exceeding the temperature rating'.
Reject any option about fault current, OCPD rating, or connected load - those describe other terms. Only B keeps both key clauses.

questions.question: Section 0 defines "bonding" as which of the following?
options: A) A connection to earth or to a conducting body that serves in place of earth
B) Any connection of metal parts using an approved clamp or lug
C) A low-impedance path obtained by permanently joining all non-current-carrying metal parts to ensure electrical continuity and the capacity to safely conduct any fault current likely to be imposed
D) The insulated path that carries normal load current back to the source
questions.question_fa: Section 0 اصطلاح bonding را به‌صورت کدام‌یک از موارد زیر تعریف می‌کند؟
options_fa: یک اتصال به زمین یا به یک conducting body که به‌جای زمین عمل می‌کند
هر اتصال قطعات فلزی با استفاده از یک clamp یا lug تأییدشده
یک مسیر low-impedance که با اتصال دائمی همه قطعات فلزی non-current-carrying به‌دست می‌آید تا continuity الکتریکی و توانایی هدایت ایمن هر fault current محتمل را تضمین کند
مسیر عایق‌شده‌ای که جریان بار عادی را به منبع بازمی‌گرداند
questions.answer_fa: یک مسیر low-impedance که با اتصال دائمی همه قطعات فلزی non-current-carrying به‌دست می‌آید تا continuity الکتریکی و توانایی هدایت ایمن هر fault current محتمل را تضمین کند
questions.answer: A low-impedance path obtained by permanently joining all non-current-carrying metal parts to ensure electrical continuity and the capacity to safely conduct any fault current likely to be imposed
solution_steps: Keyword: 'bonding'. Memorize verbatim - mnemonic 'Big Permanent Low-impedance path'.
The trap drops a key word; A is actually 'grounding', D is a normal load path. Only C keeps 'low-impedance', 'permanently', and 'fault current'.

questions.question: According to Section 0, "grounded" means connected effectively with:
options: A) The general mass of the earth, or to some conducting body that serves in place of the earth
B) All non-current-carrying metal parts by a low-impedance path
C) The identified (white) conductor of the supply
D) The service neutral at the main switch only
questions.question_fa: طبق Section 0، اصطلاح grounded یعنی به‌طور مؤثر متصل به:
options_fa: توده عمومی زمین، یا به یک conducting body که به‌جای زمین عمل می‌کند
همه قطعات فلزی non-current-carrying از طریق یک مسیر low-impedance
هادی identified (سفید) منبع
فقط service neutral در main switch
questions.answer_fa: توده عمومی زمین، یا به یک conducting body که به‌جای زمین عمل می‌کند
questions.answer: The general mass of the earth, or to some conducting body that serves in place of the earth
solution_steps: Keyword: 'grounded/grounding'. The defining idea is a connection to earth (or a body serving in place of earth).
Do not confuse with bonding (B), which joins metal parts. Only A names earth, so A is correct.

questions.question: In Section 0, equipment that is "approved" means equipment that:
options: A) Has been installed by a licensed electrical contractor
B) Is acceptable to the regulatory authority responsible for the wiring
C) Bears a recognized certification mark only
D) Has passed a manufacturer's quality-control inspection
questions.question_fa: در Section 0، تجهیزاتی که approved هستند یعنی تجهیزاتی که:
options_fa: توسط یک پیمانکار برق دارای پروانه نصب شده‌اند
برای regulatory authority مسئول wiring قابل قبول هستند
فقط دارای یک certification mark شناخته‌شده هستند
بازرسی کنترل کیفیت سازنده را پشت سر گذاشته‌اند
questions.answer_fa: برای regulatory authority مسئول wiring قابل قبول هستند
questions.answer: Is acceptable to the regulatory authority responsible for the wiring
solution_steps: Keyword: 'approved'. The CEC ties 'approved' to acceptability by the regulatory/inspection authority.
A certification mark relates to 'certified/labelled', not 'approved'. Choose B, the option referencing the regulatory authority.

questions.question: Per Section 0, a "bonding conductor" is a conductor that:
options: A) Carries the normal unbalanced load current of the circuit
B) Connects the system to a ground electrode at the service
C) Is the ungrounded supply conductor of a branch circuit
D) Connects the non-current-carrying parts of electrical equipment, raceways, or enclosures to the service equipment or system grounding conductor
questions.question_fa: طبق Section 0، یک bonding conductor هادی‌ای است که:
options_fa: جریان بار نامتعادل عادی مدار را حمل می‌کند
سیستم را به یک ground electrode در service متصل می‌کند
هادی ungrounded تغذیه یک branch circuit است
قطعات non-current-carrying تجهیزات الکتریکی، racewayها یا enclosureها را به service equipment یا system grounding conductor متصل می‌کند
questions.answer_fa: قطعات non-current-carrying تجهیزات الکتریکی، racewayها یا enclosureها را به service equipment یا system grounding conductor متصل می‌کند
questions.answer: Connects the non-current-carrying parts of electrical equipment, raceways, or enclosures to the service equipment or system grounding conductor
solution_steps: Keyword: 'bonding conductor'. It joins non-current-carrying metal parts back toward the service/system grounding conductor.
A is a neutral, B is a grounding conductor, C is an ungrounded conductor. Only D describes the bonding path - choose D.

questions.question: In Section 0, which statement correctly distinguishes a "neutral conductor" from an "identified conductor"?
options: A) They are identical terms with no difference in the Code
B) A neutral conductor is the grounding electrode conductor; an identified conductor is any bonding wire
C) A neutral conductor is the conductor connected to the neutral point of a system; an identified conductor is one intended to be recognized as the grounded (white/grey) conductor by its marking
D) A neutral conductor is always ungrounded; an identified conductor is always ungrounded too
questions.question_fa: در Section 0، کدام عبارت به‌درستی یک neutral conductor را از یک identified conductor متمایز می‌کند؟
options_fa: آن‌ها اصطلاحات یکسانی هستند و در Code تفاوتی ندارند
neutral conductor همان grounding electrode conductor است؛ identified conductor هر bonding wire است
neutral conductor هادی متصل به نقطه neutral یک سیستم است؛ identified conductor هادی‌ای است که با marking خود به‌عنوان هادی grounded (سفید/خاکستری) شناسایی می‌شود
neutral conductor همیشه ungrounded است؛ identified conductor هم همیشه ungrounded است
questions.answer_fa: neutral conductor هادی متصل به نقطه neutral یک سیستم است؛ identified conductor هادی‌ای است که با marking خود به‌عنوان هادی grounded (سفید/خاکستری) شناسایی می‌شود
questions.answer: A neutral conductor is the conductor connected to the neutral point of a system; an identified conductor is one intended to be recognized as the grounded (white/grey) conductor by its marking
solution_steps: Keywords: 'neutral conductor' vs 'identified conductor'. Neutral = connected to the neutral point; identified = marked to be recognized as the grounded conductor.
Eliminate options that call them identical or ungrounded. Only C separates the two definitions correctly.

questions.question: Section 0 defines a "dwelling unit" as:
options: A) Any building used for residential occupancy regardless of cooking facilities
B) A single bedroom rented within a larger house
C) One or more rooms used as a residence by one or more persons, containing sleeping, cooking, and sanitary facilities
D) A commercial space converted for occasional sleeping use
questions.question_fa: Section 0 یک dwelling unit را چنین تعریف می‌کند:
options_fa: هر ساختمانی که برای سکونت استفاده می‌شود، صرف‌نظر از امکانات آشپزی
یک اتاق‌خواب منفرد که در یک خانه بزرگ‌تر اجاره داده شده
یک یا چند اتاق که به‌عنوان محل سکونت توسط یک یا چند نفر استفاده می‌شود و دارای امکانات خواب، آشپزی و بهداشتی است
یک فضای تجاری که برای استفاده گاه‌به‌گاه به‌عنوان محل خواب تبدیل شده
questions.answer_fa: یک یا چند اتاق که به‌عنوان محل سکونت توسط یک یا چند نفر استفاده می‌شود و دارای امکانات خواب، آشپزی و بهداشتی است
questions.answer: One or more rooms used as a residence by one or more persons, containing sleeping, cooking, and sanitary facilities
solution_steps: Keyword: 'dwelling unit'. The three required facilities are sleeping, cooking, and sanitary, used as a residence.
This term drives Section 8 load calcs and Rule 2-110. Pick the option naming all three facilities - C.

questions.question: In Section 0, equipment described as "accessible" (as applied to wiring methods) means it:
options: A) Can be reached without requiring a portable ladder
B) Is mounted within 1.7 m of the finished floor
C) Is visible from a normal standing position
D) Is not permanently closed in by the building structure or finish, so it can be removed or exposed without damaging the building
questions.question_fa: در Section 0، تجهیزاتی که accessible توصیف می‌شوند (در کاربرد روش‌های wiring) یعنی:
options_fa: می‌توان بدون نیاز به نردبان قابل حمل به آن دسترسی پیدا کرد
در فاصله 1.7 m از کف تمام‌شده نصب شده
از حالت ایستاده عادی قابل مشاهده است
به‌طور دائمی توسط سازه یا نازک‌کاری ساختمان محصور نشده، بنابراین می‌توان آن را بدون آسیب رساندن به ساختمان برداشت یا نمایان کرد
questions.answer_fa: به‌طور دائمی توسط سازه یا نازک‌کاری ساختمان محصور نشده، بنابراین می‌توان آن را بدون آسیب رساندن به ساختمان برداشت یا نمایان کرد
questions.answer: Is not permanently closed in by the building structure or finish, so it can be removed or exposed without damaging the building
solution_steps: Keyword: 'accessible'. The test is whether it is permanently closed in by the structure/finish - if not, it is accessible.
Height and visibility are distractors. Choose D, which addresses being closed in by the building.

questions.question: Per Section 0, a "concealed" wiring method is one that is:
options: A) Rendered inaccessible by the structure or finish of the building
B) Installed in a raceway that can be opened with tools
C) Located in an attic or crawl space that is reachable
D) Run on the surface of a wall but painted over
questions.question_fa: طبق Section 0، یک روش wiring از نوع concealed روشی است که:
options_fa: توسط سازه یا نازک‌کاری ساختمان غیرقابل‌دسترس شده
در یک raceway نصب شده که می‌توان با ابزار آن را باز کرد
در یک اتاق زیرشیروانی یا crawl space قابل دسترس قرار دارد
روی سطح یک دیوار اجرا شده اما روی آن رنگ شده
questions.answer_fa: توسط سازه یا نازک‌کاری ساختمان غیرقابل‌دسترس شده
questions.answer: Rendered inaccessible by the structure or finish of the building
solution_steps: Keyword: 'concealed'. It is the opposite of 'accessible' - made inaccessible by the building structure or finish.
Wires in accessible raceways or reachable attics are still 'exposed/accessible'. Choose A.

questions.question: Section 0 defines "demand factor" as the ratio of:
options: A) The maximum demand of a system to the total connected load of the system
B) The connected load to the rating of the service conductors
C) The total connected load to the maximum demand of the system
D) The continuous load to the non-continuous load of a feeder
questions.question_fa: Section 0 اصطلاح demand factor را به‌عنوان نسبت چه چیزی تعریف می‌کند؟
options_fa: maximum demand یک سیستم به کل بار متصل آن سیستم
بار متصل به rating هادی‌های service
کل بار متصل به maximum demand سیستم
بار پیوسته به بار non-continuous یک feeder
questions.answer_fa: maximum demand یک سیستم به کل بار متصل آن سیستم
questions.answer: The maximum demand of a system to the total connected load of the system
solution_steps: Keyword: 'demand factor'. Definition: maximum demand divided by total connected load (a value of one or less).
Option C inverts the ratio - a classic trap. Choose A with maximum demand on top.

questions.question: In Section 0, "sealable equipment" means equipment that is:
options: A) Hermetically sealed against the entry of moisture and dust
B) Permanently welded shut at the factory
C) Enclosed in a case or cabinet provided with a means of sealing or locking so live parts cannot be made accessible without opening the seal
D) Marked with a tamper-resistant certification seal
questions.question_fa: در Section 0، اصطلاح sealable equipment یعنی تجهیزاتی که:
options_fa: به‌صورت hermetically در برابر ورود رطوبت و گردوغبار مهر و موم شده
در کارخانه به‌طور دائمی جوش و مسدود شده
در یک case یا cabinet محصور شده که به وسیله‌ای برای sealing یا قفل کردن مجهز است، چنان‌که قطعات live بدون باز کردن seal قابل دسترس نشوند
با یک certification seal مقاوم در برابر دستکاری marked شده
questions.answer_fa: در یک case یا cabinet محصور شده که به وسیله‌ای برای sealing یا قفل کردن مجهز است، چنان‌که قطعات live بدون باز کردن seal قابل دسترس نشوند
questions.answer: Enclosed in a case or cabinet provided with a means of sealing or locking so live parts cannot be made accessible without opening the seal
solution_steps: Keyword: 'sealable equipment'. The point is a means to seal/lock so live parts cannot be reached without breaking the seal.
'Hermetically sealed' is about moisture, not access - a distractor. Choose C.

questions.question: Based on the Section 0 voltage definitions, a nominal system voltage of 750 V is classified as:
options: A) Extra-low-voltage
B) High-voltage
C) Medium-voltage
D) Low-voltage
questions.question_fa: بر اساس تعاریف ولتاژ در Section 0، یک ولتاژ اسمی سیستم برابر 750 V در کدام دسته طبقه‌بندی می‌شود؟
options_fa: Extra-low-voltage
High-voltage
Medium-voltage
Low-voltage
solution_steps: Keyword: 'voltage classes'. Low-voltage is greater than 30 V up to and including 750 V; high-voltage is above 750 V.
The boundary is inclusive, so 750 V is the top of low-voltage, not high-voltage. Choose B.

questions.question: Per Section 0, which conductors are a "feeder"?
options: A) The conductors between the final overcurrent device and the outlet(s)
B) The conductors from the supply authority's transformer to the service box
C) Any conductors between the service box (or other source of supply) and the branch-circuit overcurrent devices
D) The grounding conductors connecting equipment to the ground electrode
questions.question_fa: طبق Section 0، کدام هادی‌ها یک feeder هستند؟
options_fa: هادی‌های بین final overcurrent device و outlet(ها)
هادی‌های بین ترانسفورماتور supply authority تا service box
هر هادی بین service box (یا منبع تغذیه دیگر) و branch-circuit overcurrent deviceها
هادی‌های grounding که تجهیزات را به ground electrode متصل می‌کنند
questions.answer_fa: هر هادی بین service box (یا منبع تغذیه دیگر) و branch-circuit overcurrent deviceها
questions.answer: Any conductors between the service box (or other source of supply) and the branch-circuit overcurrent devices
solution_steps: Keyword: 'feeder vs branch circuit'. A feeder runs from the service box (or source) up to the branch-circuit OCPD.
Option A is a branch circuit (final OCPD to outlet). The feeder ends where the branch OCPD begins - choose C.

questions.question: Using the Section 0 definitions, which statement is correct about "overcurrent" versus "overload"?
options: A) Overcurrent applies only to motors; overload applies only to conductors
B) Overcurrent and overload are identical terms in the Code

C) Overcurrent includes any current exceeding the rated ampacity (from overload, short circuit, or ground fault); overload is operation in excess of normal full-load rating, confined to the normal conducting path
D) Overload includes short circuits and ground faults; overcurrent does not
questions.question_fa: بر اساس تعاریف Section 0، کدام عبارت درباره overcurrent در برابر overload درست است؟
options_fa: overcurrent فقط برای موتورها اعمال می‌شود؛ overload فقط برای هادی‌ها
overcurrent و overload در Code اصطلاحات یکسانی هستند
overcurrent شامل هر جریانی است که از rated ampacity فراتر رود (ناشی از overload، short circuit یا ground fault)؛ overload عملکرد بیش از rated full-load عادی است که به مسیر هدایت عادی محدود می‌شود
overload شامل short circuit و ground fault است؛ overcurrent نیست
questions.answer_fa: overcurrent شامل هر جریانی است که از rated ampacity فراتر رود (ناشی از overload، short circuit یا ground fault)؛ overload عملکرد بیش از rated full-load عادی است که به مسیر هدایت عادی محدود می‌شود
questions.answer: Overcurrent includes any current exceeding the rated ampacity (from overload, short circuit, or ground fault); overload is operation in excess of normal full-load rating, confined to the normal conducting path
solution_steps: Keywords: 'overcurrent' vs 'overload'. Overcurrent is the broad term (overload + short circuit + ground fault); overload is confined to the normal path and excludes faults.
Mnemonic: overCurrent protects Conductors, overLoad protects the Load/motor. Choose C.

questions.question: Per the Section 0 duty definitions, "periodic duty" is best described as:
options: A) Operation at a substantially constant load for an indefinitely long time
B) Operation at a constant load for a short and definite time, then de-energized long enough to cool to ambient
C) Operation with widely varying loads at random intervals
D) Intermittent operation in which the load conditions recur regularly
questions.question_fa: طبق تعاریف duty در Section 0، اصطلاح periodic duty به‌بهترین شکل چگونه توصیف می‌شود؟
options_fa: عملکرد در یک بار تقریباً ثابت برای مدتی نامحدود
عملکرد در یک بار ثابت برای مدتی کوتاه و معین، سپس قطع برق به‌مدت کافی تا سرد شدن به دمای محیط
عملکرد با بارهای به‌شدت متغیر در فواصل تصادفی
عملکرد متناوب که در آن شرایط بار به‌طور منظم تکرار می‌شود
questions.answer_fa: عملکرد متناوب که در آن شرایط بار به‌طور منظم تکرار می‌شود
questions.answer: Intermittent operation in which the load conditions recur regularly
solution_steps: Keyword: 'duty cycle / periodic duty'. Periodic = intermittent operation whose load conditions recur regularly.
A is continuous duty, B is short-time duty, C is varying duty. Choose D for the regularly recurrent intermittent operation.
